relevance_note: Case series of three female patients with LAMP2 variants: "We present three female patients with Danon disease with a predominantly cardiac phenotype".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the rows and the 20-item checklist from values I chose, and every span was then checked verbatim against the paper by script. Labels 'Case 1', 'Case 2', 'Case 3' are the paper's own. No tables with patients as rows/columns other than the Timeline table; no stacked cells. Inheritance left 'not reported' for Case 1 and Case 3 although the paper calls both variants 'de novo': it does not state parental testing (rule 8 / D-24). Zygosity not stated for any case. Pathogenicity 'causal variant' comes from the abstract's statement naming all three cases. Case 3's variant c.929-1G>A is called a 'frameshift mutation' by the authors although the notation is an intronic splice-site change; recorded as stated ('frameshift') and flagged here. No transcript printed for Case 3. Contradictions: (1) Pre-excitation: Case 1 text says 'short PR interval without pre-excitation' and Case 3 text says the short PR 'could not be explained by pre-excitation', but the Discussion says pre-excitation was seen 'in Cases 1 and 3'; Case 2's text describes 'signs of pre-excitation' with a delta wave, but the Discussion says 'Case 2 had no clear signs of pre-excitation'. Both rows emitted for each case and the pre-excitation checklist item set to 'not reported' for all three (short PR alone not used for the checklist because of the explicit contradiction). (2) The Discussion says 'As Case 2 illustrated, mechanical support is sometimes needed', but the case text gives mechanical support for Case 1 only; mechanical support recorded only for Case 1. (3) Case 1: echocardiography suggested non-compaction, CMR 'did not confirm' it, explanted heart showed it; recorded as observed rows with detail, not as excluded. Normal investigations recorded under D-27 as the abnormality ruled out ('abnormal coronary angiography', 'abnormal neurological evaluation' as whole-investigation findings that exclude nothing more specific). 'None had neurological symptoms' (Discussion, names all three) used only for an excluded 'neurological symptoms' row, not to exclude checklist items; Case 1's slight learning disability is kept as observed. Case 3 'good contractility' excludes reduced contractility but not dilation, so the composite dilated/hypokinetic checklist item stays 'not reported'. Case 2 heart failure not explicitly stated (only reduced LVEF and dilated cardiomyopathy), so the heart-failure checklist item is 'not reported'. Retinal pigment changes for Case 1 rest on the Discussion statement naming all three cases plus 'Danon disease-associated eye disease in her left eye'. is_proband left null: a case series of three unrelated women, none called proband/index. Ages at last follow-up given only as dates. Age at diagnosis for Cases 1 and 3 not stated as an age (only referral ages and dates).
